meaningKo: 통제 불능 상태가 되다, 엉망이 되다
exampleEn: His plans went off the rails when he lost his job.
exampleKo: 그의 계획은 직장을 잃으면서 엉망이 되었다.
gameExamples: The project began to go off the rails after the unexpected budget cuts.
If we don't stick to the schedule, the whole event could go off the rails.
Her reaction to the news caused the conversation to go off the rails completely.
